title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_people_arent_robots_a_practical_guide_to_the_psy_by_f_annie_pettit_phd_fmria_1x20z (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_people_arent_robots_a_practical_guide_to_the_psy_by_f_annie_pettit_phd_fmria_1x20z' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
